none: PAS FindID 1012591: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of the House of Valentinian (364-378), probably Victory left, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]S AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath. Reverse inscription: probably [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 15.3mm, Weight: 1.56gms, die axis: 12
